inputs.name: document
inputs.description: A French energy performance diagnostic (DPE) of a dwelling, as a PDF

output.description: The record a letting agency files for a DPE: the figures its listing and property software need, and what the class means for letting the dwelling

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address of the dwelling the diagnostic is about, on one line, with its postcode and town, and its floor, door and lot number when the DPE gives them

fields.name: dpe_number
fields.description: The DPE's number in the ADEME register, by which it can be checked

fields.name: date_of_issue
fields.description: The date the DPE was drawn up

fields.name: date_of_expiration
fields.description: The date the DPE is valid until

fields.name: energy_efficiency_class
fields.description: The dwelling's DPE class, the one the energy and climate label gives it

fields.name: per_year_per_m2_consumption
fields.description: Primary energy consumption, in kWh per m² per year

fields.name: co2_emission_class
fields.description: The greenhouse gas emission class, read on the CO₂ emissions scale

fields.name: per_year_per_m2_co2_emissions
fields.description: Greenhouse gas emissions, in kg of CO₂ per m² per year

fields.name: yearly_energy_costs_min
fields.description: The low end of the estimated yearly energy costs, in euros

fields.name: yearly_energy_costs_max
fields.description: The high end of the estimated yearly energy costs, in euros

fields.name: energy_prices_as_of
fields.description: The date the energy prices of the cost estimate are indexed to

fields.name: letting_status
fields.description: What the class means for letting on mainland France's calendar: the standard met, or the date that bars a new or renewed lease and whether the rent is frozen; overseas, the calendar to check

fields.name: no_new_lease_from
fields.description: The date from which the class bars a lease signed, renewed or tacitly renewed, on mainland France's calendar; empty when no date bars it, or when the dwelling is overseas
